answer_1.quote: We study the performance of two long-context conversational architectures on this task: (i) retrieval-augmented generative models ; and (ii) a proposed read-write memory-based model that summarizes and stores conversation on the fly.
answer_1.outputs: generated dialogue responses and conversation summaries

answer_2.quote: We find that all three retrieval augmentation methods...can effectively use retrieval to extend the conversation history length.

answer_4.quote: We perform a human evaluation using crowdworkers.
answer_4.guideline: We ask the crowdworkers to have a natural conversation, where they will also evaluate their partner's responses for conversational attributes, in particular whether they reference knowledge of their own or the other speaker's persona (or topics they discussed) from previous sessions, from the current session, or neither. At the end of the conversation, an additional question collects an overall engagingness score (out of 5) for their speaking partner.
